about.bio: A Full Stack Developer passionate about modern web technologies, I transform ideas into high-performing applications. Currently based in Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, I juggle between PHP/Symfony, JavaScript/React, and Node.js to create solid digital experiences. My journey has taken me from Nice to Rennes, then remote in Lyon, before settling in Monaco at CruiseTech. Beyond code, I have a real talent for team management—a legacy from my years organizing international esports tournaments and coordinating gaming communities.
about.journey: A determined self-taught developer with a Master's degree in ESI, I built my expertise through concrete and varied projects. From Depiltech in Nice where I discovered Symfony, to CodeRhapsodie where I contributed to open source remotely, each step has shaped me. At CruiseTech since October 2023, I work on a complex multilingual cruise booking system, managing relational databases with several dozen tables, SOAP integrations with European insurance services, and continuous performance optimization. In parallel, I managed international teams as Tournament Lead for Amazon University Esports and Secretary General of the Student Gaming Network—experiences that taught me organization, cross-cultural communication, and crisis management.
about.passion: Web development is my comfort zone, but above all, it's an endless learning playground. I continuously train myself on the JavaScript ecosystem and its modern frameworks, while keeping a pragmatic approach: what matters is that it works well and is maintainable. Outside of code, I'm a gamer at heart—League of Legends in premade with friends, Arc Raiders for the PvPvE challenge, Forza Horizon to unwind, and Cyberpunk 2077 in stealth/hacking mode. Gaming taught me strategy, teamwork, and above all: iterating quickly after failure. These universes—dev and gaming—aren't so far apart: in both, we solve complex problems, constantly adapt, and always seek to optimize. And then there's the mountains, snowboarding, volleyball, travel, and my cats—everything that allows me to disconnect and come back with fresh ideas.
about.focus: At CruiseTech, I work daily with PHP/Symfony on a complex cruise booking system. In parallel, I continue to explore the modern JavaScript ecosystem (React, Node.js) and perfect my skills in database architecture and SQL query optimization. The goal: create robust, maintainable applications that meet real user needs.
